paragraphs: Digitalia runs an online collection of Spanish-language books and journals that readers reach through an institution. Registered readers can build lists and take out loans in Adobe DRM.

Subject coverage runs from physics, chemistry and mathematics through astronomy and the natural sciences. Social science areas include political science and law. Titles are also grouped into themed sets such as a Caribbean studies collection. Language material includes Spanish as a foreign language.

The catalog draws on named publishers, one of them a Spanish house founded in 2019 that specializes in cinema and audiovisual culture. Another is the publishing imprint of a biomedical research center. Recent additions are academic Spanish-language titles, among them one on education in the age of artificial intelligence. The copyright line on the site runs from 2013 to 2026.
